nodes.label: Owner
nodes.desc: Sets goals, gives the go-ahead for rollouts and publications, reviews DRAFTs and pilot verdicts. Every outward-facing action requires their word.

nodes.label: Agent (Claude Code session)
nodes.desc: Executes the modules: analysis, generation, rollout, evals, consolidation. Operates under the kit's contracts and slash commands.

nodes.label: Spec & v0 scope
nodes.desc: Goals, non-goals and boundaries of the pipeline. Scope discipline: anything extra goes to BACKLOG with activation conditions.

nodes.label: DECISIONS / BLOCKERS
nodes.desc: Log of autonomous decisions and blockers. Also holds the zero-wrapping principle (#9).

nodes.label: conveyor.config
nodes.desc: Target project parameters: branches, Node versions, build commands. `# conveyor:` markers in templates show what to change.

nodes.label: Session docs
nodes.desc: Fresh-session entry point, last-session snapshot, handoffs - continuity between agent sessions.

nodes.label: 01 ci-core
nodes.desc: PR pipeline: lint + unit + build on every push. npm cache, concurrency cancellation, test summary.

nodes.label: 02 mobile-build
nodes.desc: Android/iOS builds of the Capacitor app.

nodes.label: 03 store-deploy
nodes.desc: Google Play and App Store playbooks: keys, deep links (vercel.json template), listing, AAB auto-upload.

nodes.label: 04 staging
nodes.desc: Staging environment and QA cleanup via RPC under JWT - the reference secrets model.

nodes.label: 05 monitoring
nodes.desc: Sentry: release tags, sourcemaps, alerts.

nodes.label: 06 secrets
nodes.desc: Secrets hygiene: gitleaks, checklists, no service role in CI or client code.

nodes.label: 07 smoke-e2e
nodes.desc: Playwright smoke suite: 5-8 scenarios, single shard.

nodes.label: 08 agent-layer
nodes.desc: Agent roles and prompts for applying the pipeline: AGENTS.md, apply-kit. Module order: 1-6-4-7-5-2-3.

nodes.label: 09 prompt-library
nodes.desc: 14 slash commands + 21 prompt-menu entries across 6 phases + PATTERNS. Stack-independent core, dogfooded by the kit itself via symlinks.

nodes.label: usage-digest
nodes.desc: What actually got used this week: commands, skills, subagents. Zero calls = rename or drop candidate.

nodes.label: lib-transcripts
nodes.desc: Shared transcript reader for modules 09/11/12: files within a window, counters, typed prompts.

nodes.label: 11 command-evals
nodes.desc: Command quality as a number: layer 1 - structural checks against expectations.tsv, layer 2 - LLM judge over cases. The metric is always reported as two layers.

nodes.label: 12 memory-consolidation
nodes.desc: File-based Dreaming analog: deterministic raw-material collection outside the git tree, distillation into a DRAFT by a command, manual acceptance.

nodes.label: 13 arch-viz
nodes.desc: This visualization: data refreshed by an in-session command (auto-trigger: a freshness hook on every prompt), HTML built deterministically, CI pings Telegram when stale.

nodes.label: check-provenance
nodes.desc: Reconciles vendored copies with the kit: kit@sha stamps, lag behind HEAD, changed sources.

nodes.label: ROLLOUT (rollout spec)
nodes.desc: The full block-A rollout prompt for a project: commands, menu, guide, tooling, gitignore, verification. Carries the zero-wrapping registry.

nodes.label: Wrapping registry
nodes.desc: What every project receives: project level (commands, plugins) and machine level (rtk, pinned clones). Entry only via pilot verdict or audit.

nodes.label: Vendored copy in a project
nodes.desc: tools/prompt-kit/ + .claude/commands/ + docs/prompts/ of the target project. The project owns its copy; drift is caught by check-provenance.

nodes.label: Target project
nodes.desc: The repository receiving the wrapping: a stack-specific release pipeline plus the stack-independent prompt-kit layer.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions
nodes.desc: Runs the pipeline templates and the arch-viz workflow: builds, checks, staleness reports.

nodes.label: Session transcripts
nodes.desc: Local Claude Code history - the source of truth for digest, evals ranking and consolidation.

nodes.label: Project private zone
nodes.desc: A directory next to the project's memory, outside the git tree: consolidation raw material and DRAFTs. One rule across all platforms.

nodes.label: Stores & hosting
nodes.desc: Google Play, App Store, Vercel: the app's delivery endpoints.

flows.name: Block A rollout into a project
flows.desc: Full deployment of the stack-independent layer into a target project

steps.text: Gives the go-ahead for a rollout into a specific project.
Opens the target project's session and takes the rollout prompt.
Walks through the steps: commands, menu, guide, tooling, gitignore, provenance stamps.
The project gets its own copy of the layer (tools/prompt-kit + .claude/commands).
The project is self-sufficient; verification: eval.sh, check-provenance, consolidate smoke.

flows.name: Command quality evals
flows.desc: Two-layer check of slash commands: structure + behavior

steps.text: Invokes /eval-command (manually or as part of verification).
The sources of all 14 commands are the subject under test.
Layer 1: structural invariants against expectations.tsv; layer 2: LLM judge over cases. Scorecard with delta.

flows.name: Memory consolidation
flows.desc: Distilling session raw material into reviewable insights

steps.text: Project session history accumulates.
consolidate.sh gathers the activity window via the shared reader.
Raw material is shaped into material-<date>.md, deterministically and for free.
Material and DRAFTs live outside the git tree (privacy, PHI).
/consolidate-memory distills the material into a DRAFT per the rubric.
Reviews the DRAFT; accepted parts are merged into memory and .ai/ by hand.

flows.name: Architecture visualization refresh
flows.desc: Hybrid: LLM analysis in-session, deterministic build, CI freshness

steps.text: /arch-viz analyzes the repository and updates arch-data.json.
build-arch-viz.sh validates invariants and inlines the data into the template.
On push to main: rebuild if the HTML lags + staleness report; when stale - a Telegram ping to the project topic (hard guarantee).

flows.name: App release pipeline
flows.desc: The stack-specific wrapping path: from CI to the stores

steps.text: apply-kit walks the agent through module order 1-6-4-7-5-2-3.
PR pipeline: lint + unit + build.
Secrets hygiene and the gitleaks gate.
The target project's workflows run checks and builds.
Store playbooks: keys, deep links, listing.
The app reaches Google Play / App Store / Vercel.
